limits_note: per-object-cap 500 MB. Files cannot be modified or renamed after upload. Files API request size capped at 500 MB (Messages 32 MB, Batch 256 MB).
reliability_note: HARD READ GATE, stated in the docs not in a forum. 'Download files that were created by skills or the code execution tool. **Files you upload cannot be downloaded.**' This is the brief's rule 2 in its purest form: huge quota, real write path, no read path for your own bytes. Uploading is therefore write-only data loss. (Anthropic separately requires phone verification for new Console accounts.)
